prompt.project_info: Create photorealistic high-fidelity tropical fashion photography with realistic skin texture and shallow depth of field.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with long wavy dark hair and a tanned complexion, natural feminine silhouette, and confident direct gaze. She wears a red, orange, and dark-green tie-dye bikini with small triangle cups, thin red strings, a central gold ring, and low-rise side-tie bottoms. Preserve the small cross tattoo on the lower right abdomen near the bikini line as a non-graphic identity detail.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing front-facing with a slight hip shift, right arm down and left hand resting near the chin. Frame vertically from upper thighs to slightly cropped top of head, eye-level straight-on, with dense Monstera-like foliage and tropical plants behind her, softly out of focus.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural front-right overhead sunlight, soft shadows under the chin and arms, warm lifelike skin glow, high-contrast highlights on shoulders and chest area, tropical sun-drenched atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Medium vertical shot, eye-level, three-dimensional depth without lens compression, photorealistic high-fidelity photography, shallow depth of field, realistic pores and slight natural skin sheen.
